correctness.rationale: Order-five de Bruijn cycles are in bijection with Euler tours of the 4-bit overlap digraph, normalized at the unique 00000 edge. The provided checker enumerates rooted full edge tours; a second independently described 2^16 local-edge-order traversal is consistent. I independently wrote a fresh DFS over all 32 directed 5-bit edges and enumerated all 2048 canonical cycles, then computed distinct literal cyclic palindrome strings by scanning each of 32 starts and lengths 1..32. Independently recovered exact P frequencies {22:32,23:32,24:200,27:192,28:920,29:544,30:128}, longest L frequencies {7:200,8:192,9:856,10:128,11:392,12:32,13:200,15:48}, 23 joint (P,L) values and 51 lengthwise profiles. The complete finite exhaustive bijection, not a sample, proves the stated finite domain.
